# Task: build and improve a chess engine from scratch

Create a single Python file named `engine.py`. It must use only the Python standard library and speak enough UCI to play:

```text
uci
isready
ucinewgame
position startpos [moves ...]
position fen <six-field-fen> [moves ...]
go movetime <ms>
quit
```

For every `go movetime` command, return exactly one legal `bestmove <uci_move>` before the deadline. Implement the board,
legal move generation, state transitions, search, and evaluation yourself. Do not import or inspect `python-chess`, Stockfish,
Sunfish, TSCP, Fairy-Stockfish, LC0, or any other chess engine or chess library.

This is an offline closed-book task. Do not use web/search, network access, package installation, apps, MCP, plugins,
subagents, other repositories, system documentation, or files outside the supplied benchmark workspace. The evaluator's
Stockfish binary, opening list, hidden match output, and other candidates are not visible to you. In a plateau entry you may
inspect and modify only the explicitly supplied previous `engine.py` and public feedback.

The official match uses 50 fixed opening positions with colors exchanged for exactly 100 games at each immutable Stockfish
node tier. Candidate move time, maximum plies, Stockfish binary, opening bytes, and statistics are evaluator-side frozen
contracts. Do not hard-code a supplied opening list or attempt to identify individual evaluation games.

Leave only `engine.py` as the final engine artifact.


# V3 Lite complete-file response boundary

This adapted research track evaluates the engine produced by the active V3 Lite harness. The engine itself remains offline, standard-library-only, and unable to use tools or other files. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose: {"files":{"engine.py":"<the complete Python source, JSON escaped>"}}. Do not return a patch or Markdown fence. The evaluator plays 50 fixed openings with colors exchanged, for exactly 100 games. The evaluation stage and opponent tier are hidden control-plane conditions. Public suite label: screening.
